LanguageData.GrechkaDrones_CaptureDesc: Carry downed enemies to available prison beds. Always rescue your own first, dropping a carried enemy if necessary.
LanguageData.GrechkaDrones_BioEnergyTip: Bioenergy: {0}. A full battery stores 2 nutrition for one day of activity. At the colony, a reachable powered dock takes priority. If charging is unavailable, the drone refuels with food portions based on nutrition. Resting in a caravan does not recharge the battery.
